_note: Native Wave 2 media-hub lane. The port is proven offline (jest-expo + RNTL against a fake MediaHubData, a recording Supabase client and a fixture gateway; no network; the native app has no production profile and assertNotProduction() refuses prod and staging hosts). This lane makes no staging call and writes nothing to Supabase, Storage or the gateway from a test: every like, bookmark, comment, edit, delete and upload is asserted on the fake or the recorder only. Device-runtime parity (Maestro journeys, simulator and emulator screenshots, parity against the 390x844 read-only staging web /comm/media-hub, real expo-video / expo-audio playback and the pickers on a device) is deferred to G1 as next_actor: owner. It is recorded here, not run in CI, and is not a merge blocker.
